summary: RETEST PASS — iteration-4 critical bug (Notices kebab → ReportSheet unreachable) is FIXED. Verified end-to-end on web preview (390x844): demo-login as Frank → /notices → tap kebab on a non-author notice → 'NOTICE OPTIONS' bottom-sheet appears with 'Report notice' + 'Block <user>' options (Alert.alert no longer used) → tap 'Report notice' → ReportSheet bottom-sheet opens showing all 6 reasons (Spam, Harassment / Bullying, Inappropriate Content, Fake Profile, Scam / Suspicious Behaviour, Other) + EXTRA DETAILS notes field + Cancel/Submit → pick Spam, tap Submit → POST /api/reports returns 200 → sheet transitions to Thank-you stage with 'Thank you.', body 'We've received your report and will review it.', red 'Block this user' button, and 'Done' button. Verified report lands in admin queue (GET /api/admin/reports?admin_id=maggie&status=all) as {reason='Spam', target_type='notice', reporter='frankie', status='new'}. Backend regression: all 16 existing pytest cases in test_admin_safety.py still PASS. New test file test_demo_login_guard.py adds 3 cases verifying the new banned/suspended guard on /api/auth/demo-login (active user → 200, suspended → 403 + 'suspended' in body, banned → 403 + 'banned' in body, restore → 200 again) — all 3 PASS. NOTE on the path: a stale Metro bundle was serving the old notices.tsx and threw 'ReferenceError: actionMenu is not defined' until we cleared /app/frontend/.metro-cache and restarted expo — after that, the screen rendered cleanly with zero console errors. Pre-existing react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) still present but non-blocking.

Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use textShadow.' (Pre-existing)

action_items: Optional — Migrate deprecated RN-Web style props shadow*/textShadow* → boxShadow/textShadow, and move pointerEvents from props to style (pre-existing, app-wide).

Optional housekeeping — onReport() in /app/frontend/app/notices.tsx (line 100) is now dead code (only setReportFor is used by the action sheet); consider removing it and the legacy api.reportNotice() helper so the new /api/reports flow is the single source of truth.

Heads-up — Metro can serve a stale bundle for a long while after edits; recommend including `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache && sudo supervisorctl restart expo` in dev/runbook after substantive edits to notices.tsx or similar screens.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/notices.tsx:119-122 — showActions() now sets actionMenuFor (state), the in-component Modal at line 299 mounts a bottom-sheet with the options. This is the correct cross-platform pattern (Alert.alert is silent on react-native-web). Verified working.

/app/frontend/app/notices.tsx:100-103 — onReport() simplified to `setReportFor(n)`; the kebab option 'Report notice' (line 134) also calls setReportFor directly, so the ReportSheet is now reachable. Legacy api.reportNotice path effectively retired.

/app/backend/server.py:386-400 — /auth/demo-login now mirrors /auth/login: banned → 403 + admin notification (moderation_login_attempt), suspended_until in future → 403 + admin notification, expired suspension cleared inline. Parity achieved; verified by test_demo_login_guard.py (3/3 pass).
server.py is still ~2.69k lines — long-standing recommendation to split admin/safety/games into separate route modules for maintainability.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_demo_login_guard.py (new — 3 demo-login banned/suspended guard pytest cases, all passing)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://belong-together.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin/safety regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_safety.py /app/backend/tests/test_demo_login_guard.py -v (19 tests, ~6s). Admin demo: POST /api/auth/demo-login {username:'maggie'} → user.is_admin=true. To reproduce the Notices report flow in the web preview: demo-login as Frank (non-admin), navigate to /notices, click the three-dot kebab (visually at ~x=346 on a 390-wide viewport) on a notice authored by someone else — the bottom-sheet 'NOTICE OPTIONS' appears with testID-less Pressables labeled 'Report notice' and 'Block <user>'. rca_of_issue: Iteration-4 RCA confirmed fixed: (1) notices.tsx:119-122 showActions() now sets actionMenuFor (state) → the Modal at line 299 renders the bottom-sheet — cross-platform safe (no more Alert.alert which is silent on web). (2) The 'Report notice' button inside the action sheet (line 134) and onReport() (line 100) both now call setReportFor(n), which mounts ReportSheet at line 287, so the 6-reason taxonomy flow is reachable. (3) /auth/demo-login (server.py:386-400) now applies the same banned/suspended guard as /auth/login. During the retest we briefly hit a 'ReferenceError: actionMenu is not defined' error coming from a stale Metro bundle that didn't reflect the on-disk source — clearing /app/frontend/.metro-cache and restarting expo fixed it. No code changes needed beyond that; the source on disk is already correct.
